production: exact-image C ubusd remains active on the router; candidate is isolated and never installed
hypothesis: One event-loop stack [u8;4096], initialized once, replaces per-client read-ahead storage. Only incomplete bytes survive in a client-owned exact-length Vec; InMsg remains owned.

frozen_design.shared_buffer_scope: one [u8;4096] initialized outside the event-loop while; borrowed for one complete service round, no per-message Vec swapping
frozen_design.complete_batch: keep shared buffer during one service_client call while coalesced complete frames are dispatched
frozen_design.partial_frame: copy only residual [rx_start,rx_end) to exact-size client Vec when service call returns
frozen_design.fd_marks: subtract residual start when compacting; preserve frame boundary ownership

router_measurement.statistical_unit: one ratio per independent physical window; segments aggregated within window
router_measurement.production_cleanup: stock C production, same boot/config/mount, health and cleanup required after every window

decision.memory: In each of two repeated physical blocks: (RssAnon_64 - RssAnon_0_for_same_fresh_process) / 64 <= 0.6 KiB per connection, i.e. growth <=38.4 KiB. Report C, R89, R103 and R109 as fresh controls, all absolute values and page-granularity limits.
decision.cpu: For EACH lane, ten-window R110-A/R103 daemon CPU must not all increase; ten positive ratios in ANY lane rejects pending counter-based diagnosis. Also compare against R109 to isolate the code change. Mixed signs do not establish equivalence. Report intervals and total CPU; systematic regression is not accepted just because one sign is negative.
decision.next: R110-B is separately frozen only after R110-A passes

amendment.reason: Initial draft mistakenly substituted heap Vec swapping for the requested stack array, counted the listener as a connection and loosened the memory threshold. None of its ELFs ran on the router. Correct before testing.
